name: The derivation
owner: the computation, and never a person
smallest: one stored record with its inputs, its time and the version of the code that produced it
status_note: Nine stored deltas, each pinning the profile version, the mandate version, the pack version, the time and abp.delta/v1, recomputed by the gate on every build. What is missing is the series, the trigger and the crossing. No field on any node here is authored: a Trigger is received, a Crossing is computed, a Series is appended.

node_types.name: Excess
node_types.formula: [Excess] := a [GrantedCapability] with NO -authorised_by-> path to the [Mandate] in scope

node_types.name: Shortfall
node_types.formula: [Shortfall] := a [Capability] that a [Mandate] -authorises-> and no [DeploymentShape] in scope -grants->

node_types.name: DeltaRecord
node_types.formula: a node -derived_from-> exactly one [GrantVersion] and exactly one [MandateVersion], -computed_by-> one [Computation], with an excess, an unbounded excess and a shortfall set; no field writable by a person
node_types.note: Exists as a file under data/deltas/ and not yet as a node in the graph.

node_types.name: Computation
node_types.formula: a version of the code: abp.delta/v1 today

node_types.name: Series
node_types.formula: the ordered set of [DeltaRecord]s for one shape and one mandate, each -supersedes-> the last

node_types.name: Trigger
node_types.formula: an event that -causes_recompute-> of a [Series]: a credential change, a token claims change, an assurance level change, a device compliance change; a new observation in U3; a corrected mandate in U5; a new pack version in U1

node_types.name: Crossing
node_types.formula: a [DeltaRecord] whose count -crosses-> a [Threshold] somebody set in advance; a record, never a verdict

verbs.reads_as: this granted capability exceeds this mandate
verbs.inverse_reads_as: this mandate is exceeded by these granted capabilities

verbs.reads_as: this record was derived from these pinned inputs
verbs.inverse_reads_as: these inputs were derived into this record

verbs.reads_as: this record was computed by this version of the code
verbs.inverse_reads_as: this version of the code computed these records

verbs.reads_as: this event caused this series to recompute
verbs.inverse_reads_as: this series was recomputed on this event
this threshold is crossed by these records

adds: The gate's twelfth check, which recomputes every stored delta from its pinned inputs, extends to the series without a new idea: every record in a series recomputes, and a series with a gap in its supersedes chain fails the build. Lab 07's history folder, one entry per recompute, is the live instance of Series and it exists in riskmandate.ai's vault today.

provenance.note: The universe is authored in admin/build/universes.py; the matched counts and the live junctions are computed from the graph on every build.
